research_question: How does venue architecture change counterparty, execution, funding and liquidity-provider risk in perpetual DEXs?
scope: Public documentation of Sai, Hyperliquid, GMX and dYdX Chain. Feature matrix is qualitative; not a live performance ranking.

protocols.name: Sai
protocols.collateral_and_settlement: USDC / stNIBI supported; self-custodied; gasless trading (bridge gas still possible)
protocols.funding_model: OI-imbalance borrowing fee charged to crowded side; not necessarily paid to opposite-side traders
protocols.fee_mechanism: 0.05% base taker; 0% maker; 0.01% trigger; additional decaying rapid-close fee applies to very short holds
protocols.risk_focus: Oracle integrity, pool solvency, dynamic leverage and rapid-close costs
protocols.caveat: Fee schedule and protected market parameters can change; no direct performance claim.

protocols.name: Hyperliquid
protocols.liquidity: Resting maker orders and market makers
protocols.funding_model: Perpetual funding payments for spot-price convergence
protocols.fee_mechanism: Order book spread and maker/taker economics (rates excluded pending fee-tier snapshot)
protocols.risk_focus: Order-book depth, market-maker concentration, oracle/mark and margining
protocols.caveat: Order-book state may diverge from quoted liquidity under stress; effective fees vary by account tier.

protocols.name: GMX
protocols.collateral_and_settlement: Liquidity pools back trader profits and losses
protocols.fee_mechanism: Published open/close fees and separate open-interest-imbalance price impact, borrowing and network fees
protocols.risk_focus: Pool PnL limits, utilization and withdrawal constraints
protocols.caveat: Fee and price impact vary by market, position and conditions.

protocols.name: dYdX Chain
protocols.execution: Validator-maintained in-memory order books with block matching
protocols.collateral_and_settlement: Cosmos SDK application-chain software; validator consensus
protocols.funding_model: Perpetual market funding (specific rate formulas not compared)
protocols.fee_mechanism: Order book / maker-taker design; absolute rates excluded pending current protocol snapshot
protocols.risk_focus: Order dissemination, mempool latency, consensus, liquidations
protocols.caveat: Documentation applies to dYdX Chain software; deployed instances can vary.
